notes.usage: This file contains the complete taxonomy for InterviewExplainer. Load it once on first startup.
notes.domainStructure: Each domain is a combination of: Language + Track + Experience Level
notes.totalDomains: 64 domains (8 languages × 2-4 tracks per language × 4 experience levels)
notes.stacksNote: Stacks are defined in separate JSON files in the stacks/ directory. Each domain references multiple stacks organized by categories.
notes.categoriesPerDomain: Each domain has 3-8 categories (e.g., language, framework, database, devops, cloud)
notes.stacksPerDomain: Each domain references 10-50 stacks depending on experience level
notes.nextSteps: 1. Load this file to populate languages, tracks, experience_levels, and domains. 2. Load stack definitions from individual stack JSON files. 3. Create domain_stack_map relationships.
